notes.title: Boris and twitch
notes.notes:
Greetings everyone! Boris has spent a lot of time in the bunker in front of his beloved TV and eventually he decided to vary his grey days by different challenges.
We are happy to announce that we have an integration with Twitch for live steams.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38617053/3f2d69d5aa8a4d2729b54ef97a11ad35df5e2cee.jpg[/img]

Stream integration will start working after Boris's 4th workday.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38617053/7c0768c6fbdfea1895fdc6ca6a894d19e0b2a824.jpg[/img]

The viewers can choose one of three proposed options.
Event list:
MILK - Consume condensed milk.
VIEW INVERSION - Everyone likes inverted controls right?!
MOVE INVERSION - Left is right, right is left.
VODKA - Your liver won't be happy about it.
FAST - Now you will rub a bit faster.
SLOW - Maybe you don't need to be hurry at all...
WEAK HANDS - Have you been carrying something? Not anymore!
BEARS - It's not only one bear outside, but whole bear family.
AIRDROP - Crate from the sky?
OPEN DOOR - The bunker's door will be open now, don't forget to close it or you get cold.
CONSOLE RESET - Have you been setting up toggle switches? Oops...
FASTER ROCKET - The missiles will fly faster now.
EYES - It's getting dark in the eyes...
QUAKE - Is everything shaking around you?
SPAWN ROCKET - Someone definitely does not like you...
AUTO JUMP - No need to go to gym now. 

[b]If you have any questions, contact by mail: info@tor-studio.com[/b]

notes.title: BORIS THE ROCKET demo
notes.notes:
[b]BORIS THE ROCKET[/b] - is a simulator with RPG elements, where you have to survive in the harsh, cold Siberian forest conditions.

The story of this game begins with simple and well known to everyone "why not to try it?" and "what can go wrong?"
Boris looks pretty similar to one of the post soviet countries politician, being in his own garage mixing cola with mentos in the plastic bottle. 
And... And it takes off comrades. And right after that KGB knocks the door and offers Boris to make a voyage he never dreamed about of.
Just like you. Have you ever dreamed about Boris? We can assure you, soon you will have an irresistible desire to press the button.
It turned out as an interesting simulator of a mustached missile operator with selection of most popular stereotypes, but in a nice package.

There are a lot of things to be done  - develop your character, fight back the enemy missiles, distil the vital potion and even feed the bear.
Main target of the game is to build "STEPAN" the Intercontinental ballistic missile.
But while you are building "STEPAN", you have to defend your bunker against enemy missiles. To eliminate enemy missiles you have to identify them and configure your anti-ballistic missile by using the main console.
The story line is based on bunker's past that you will discover while solving puzzles.
